title: Canonical Product Envelope Tightening Contract
branch_scope: phase-5/prep — additive contract only; no activation; no merge to main until Phases 0–4 evidence fossils exist
purpose: Tighten the existing product and Elohim-candidate envelopes without creating a competing product schema. This contract defines the cross-schema invariants every product candidate and sellable product must satisfy.
reconciles_with: existing commerce SKU contract and CUBE clone contracts
non_goals: Does not replace or fork existing product or candidate JSON Schemas
Does not create inventory, assert rights, or infer demand
Does not create Stripe products, prices, payment links, orders, or checkout sessions
Does not authorise publication, checkout, silo activation, or revenue claims
Does not permit a schema-valid record to bypass supply verification, Gauntlet, activation approval, the CSO, settlement, fulfillment, delivery, or independent verification

identity.product_id: Stable non-empty product identifier; immutable after external references exist.
identity.canonical_sku: A single canonical SKU is required before sellable status. Null, blank, unknown, duplicate, or conflicting SKU values fail closed.
identity.silo_slug: Exactly one owning silo. The product envelope silo and verified supply silo must match; cross-silo reuse is rejected.
identity.name: Non-empty human-readable name. Name similarity is not identity and must not be used to merge distinct products automatically.

price.candidate_price: A proposal only; it is not a live price and must never be rendered as a purchasable price.
price.sellable_price: Must resolve to exactly one authoritative price source for the canonical SKU, with an explicit currency and unambiguous unit convention.
price.existing_product_price_unit: When the existing product schema uses price, price_unit must be present and valid. The values major, minor, and cents must not be silently mixed or guessed; the authoritative adapter must normalize them before checkout.
price.currency: Must be a supported ISO 4217 currency code represented consistently at the boundary. Existing schema support for NZD/nzd does not imply support for other currencies.
price.conflict: Multiple price proposals, conflicting catalog/processor amounts, missing unit, unsupported currency, or an absent authoritative price source forces HOLD.

lifecycle.candidate: Generated or imported ideas remain candidates; they are not inventory and cannot expose active checkout.
lifecycle.supply_verified: Requires a current VERIFIED supply atom satisfying VERIFIED-SUPPLY-CONTRACT-v1.
lifecycle.gauntlet_approved: Requires a recorded Gauntlet decision fossil for the exact product, SKU, silo, price source, and supply atom.
lifecycle.activation_approved: Requires a separate explicit activation approval fossil for the exact product and silo after prior gates pass.
lifecycle.published: Publication is presentation state only. It cannot imply supply, checkout readiness, settlement, delivery, or revenue.
lifecycle.checkout_enabled: Permitted only when supply verification, Gauntlet approval, activation approval, authoritative price resolution, fulfillment-registry readiness, and CSO routing are all independently evidenced. Missing or stale evidence means disabled.

clone_isolation.new_silo_shell: Must start with an empty product catalog and no sellable supply atoms.
forbidden_inheritance: verified supply decisions or evidence fossils from another silo
Stripe product IDs, price IDs, payment links, webhook secrets, or credentials
activation approvals, checkout-enabled flags, or buyer/order/payment records
allowed_inheritance: disabled example records explicitly labelled TEST or SIMULATED

fail_closed_rules.condition: Product identity is absent, malformed, or duplicates another active canonical product identity without an explicit reviewed alias
A product is proposed as sellable without one valid canonical SKU, or catalog, supply, and event SKU values disagree
Product silo differs from supply atom, approved activation scope, or attributed economic event
Price has no explicit currency/unit/authoritative source, or candidate, catalog, and processor prices conflict
A generated candidate or proposed price is treated as verified stock, service capacity, or a live purchasable offer
Product is published or shows an inventory count without a matching current VERIFIED supply atom
Checkout is enabled before supply verification, Gauntlet, activation approval, authoritative price, fulfillment readiness, and canonical settlement routing are evidenced
New silo clone contains inherited inventory, supply proof, credentials, Stripe identifiers, checkout state, orders, or revenue totals
Schema validity is used as a substitute for external evidence or any downstream approval gate

rules: A PASS decision advances only to the named next gate and never skips a gate.
A fossil must identify the exact envelope version or content hash evaluated.
A fossil with missing source references, unresolved conflicts, or stale evidence is invalid and cannot authorise progression.
Decision fossils are append-only; corrections create a new fossil linked to the superseded fossil.

next_step: Implement executable adversarial tests against the existing schemas and these invariants. Test preparation does not authorise activation, checkout, production writes, or merge.
